description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class named UpdateTaxonomyMappingCommandHandler, which implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface. Its primary responsibility is to handle 'UPDATE' commands related to taxonomy mappings within the Fineract platform, specifically for the 'XBRLMAPPING' entity. It depends on the MixTaxonomyMappingWritePlatformService to perform the actual update operation.

classes.name: UpdateTaxonomyMappingCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles update commands for taxonomy mapping entities in the Fineract platform, delegating the update operation to the relevant service.
